title: Fox in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Fox body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='26' ry='20' fill='#E8701A'/>
  <!-- Belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='15' ry='13' fill='#FFE8C8'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='24' ry='20' fill='#E8701A'/>
  <!-- Left ear -->
  <polygon points='30,40 26,20 42,32' fill='#E8701A'/>
  <polygon points='32,37 30,25 40,33' fill='#FFB88C'/>
  <!-- Right ear -->
  <polygon points='70,40 74,20 58,32' fill='#E8701A'/>
  <polygon points='68,37 70,25 60,33' fill='#FFB88C'/>
  <!-- Face lighter patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='54' rx='16' ry='12' fill='#FFE8C8'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='45' rx='4' ry='4.5' fill='#2A2A4A'/>
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='45' rx='4' ry='4.5' fill='#2A2A4A'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='43.5' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='43.5' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='3.5' ry='2.5' fill='#2A2A4A'/>
  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d='M47,58 Q50,61 53,58' stroke='#C0550A' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Scarf around neck -->
  <path d='M26,64 Q50,72 74,64 L74,70 Q50,78 26,70 Z' fill='#3DB86B'/>
  <!-- Scarf stripe lighter -->
  <path d='M28,66 Q50,73 72,66' stroke='#7BE8A8' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Scarf tail -->
  <path d='M68,68 Q78,72 76,84 Q74,88 70,86 Q72,80 70,72 Z' fill='#3DB86B'/>
  <path d='M70,74 Q74,78 73,84' stroke='#7BE8A8' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Paws -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='94' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#E8701A'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='94' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#E8701A'/>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d='M76,78 Q90,72 88,60 Q86,54 80,58 Q84,66 74,72 Z' fill='#E8701A'/>
  <path d='M88,60 Q86,54 80,58 Q82,62 84,62 Z' fill='#FFE8C8'/>
</svg>
